answer: The Registered domain bound by one-time code delivery with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Like a forge on a key ring, one odd key hides easily, so the check runs on every binding rather than a sample. A inlet alone is noise; a ocean of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
